method: Fresh, independently agent-authored raw-text holdout scored once after implementation/metric/dataset freeze. Deterministic parser → local versioned requirement matcher; one timed pipeline sample per case after independent warmup.
limitations: Synthetic reference labels were authored independently of application output, not provided by independent human reviewers.
Skill extraction and classification are measured; the initial gold set does not measure experience/constraint correctness, OCR, visual layout or actual job performance.
The new holdout is small, synthetic and English-dominant; no population confidence interval or real hiring outcome is established.
This is the initial scored run of this newly authored holdout against the preregistered unchanged implementation. After publication, reruns are regression evidence only.
Citation integrity checks the parsed data path and exact quote, while unsupported claims compare the matching decision with raw-input reference labels.
This run does not measure live LLM accuracy, latency, token consumption, queue/API latency or provider pricing.

annotationScope.evidencePolicy: Use explicit candidate evidence from the resume and explicit skill categories from the job description. An unresolved first-person contradiction makes the requirement uncertain and keeps the skill out of expected extraction.
